# Claude Daily Memory

> Turn useful work from every Claude Code terminal and project into a growing NotebookLM knowledge base—a searchable second brain for decisions, plans, findings, and unfinished work.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory
Website: https://geft1310-hue.github.io/claude-daily-memory/
Documentation: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory#readme
Security policy: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory/security/policy
License: Apache-2.0

## Problem and outcome

Claude Code sessions and projects are separate, so useful context is easy to lose. Claude Daily Memory collects selected outcomes across terminals, builds one structured daily memory, and maintains a Google Doc that can be connected to NotebookLM as a normal Drive source.

NotebookLM then becomes the user-facing knowledge layer for searching accumulated work, recovering decisions, comparing projects, preparing briefings, finding recurring patterns, and creating any summaries, reports, FAQs, mind maps, audio overviews, or other outputs available in the user's NotebookLM account.

Claude Daily Memory is the ingestion and maintenance layer. It does not claim to provide a consumer NotebookLM API or remotely operate NotebookLM features.

## Core facts

- The primary use case is long-term, cross-project memory for Claude Code through NotebookLM.
- Multiple Claude Code terminals and projects contribute to one daily knowledge stream.
- The software preserves curated plans, decisions, notes, reports, verification results, and safe activity counts.
- The software does not read raw Claude Code transcripts.
- It does not automatically collect full prompts, full assistant responses, commands, tool input/output, Gmail messages, or arbitrary project files.
- Each artifact and the complete digest are scanned for secrets before networking.
- The pipeline fails closed when scanning, parsing, authentication, or document update is uncertain.
- A readable Markdown digest is created locally first.
- Google export uses the official Drive and Docs APIs with the narrow `drive.file` scope.
- Refresh tokens must be stored in an operating-system Secret Service.
- NotebookLM integration uses a normal Google Drive source, not private consumer APIs, browser cookies, or browser automation.
- Depending on current NotebookLM account behavior, the Drive source may require a normal manual refresh.
- Gmail cleanup and the explicit-text Gemini bridge are optional tools separated from the automatic memory pipeline.

## Important files

- `README.md`: product explanation, use cases, installation, and architecture (English)
- `README-RU.md`: the same documentation in Russian
- `docs/GOOGLE-RU.md`: step-by-step Google and NotebookLM setup guide in Russian
- `src/claude_daily_memory/hooks.py`: allowlisted cross-terminal lifecycle metadata
- `src/claude_daily_memory/digest.py`: deterministic cross-project daily memory builder
- `src/claude_daily_memory/sanitize.py`: fail-closed secret and personal-data scanner
- `src/claude_daily_memory/google_drive.py`: official Drive and Docs writer
- `src/claude_daily_memory/job.py`: local-to-Google daily pipeline
- `src/claude_daily_memory/gmail_rules.py`: exact reversible cleanup decisions
- `src/claude_daily_memory/gemini_bridge.py`: explicit-text-only Gemini bridge
- `SECURITY.md`: private vulnerability reporting instructions
